description: Above 500 items the chunk export is sharded: /chunks-01.jsonl holds the lines of the first 500 items in slug order, /chunks-02.jsonl the rest, no item split across shards, and /chunks.jsonl becomes the JCS manifest {"lines_total", "shards"}.
